description: Google User Messaging Platform (UMP) consent SDK and its IAB TCF v2.2 consent storage. This entry does NOT merely stub the SDK: it INJECTS code that suppresses the consent dialog and writes a reject-all IAB TCF v2.2 consent state to the default SharedPreferences, so every TCF-honoring ad/tracker SDK self-limits (no personalized ads, no data sharing). See references/consent-neutralization.md. It COMPLEMENTS per-SDK neutralization — non-TCF SDKs (Firebase, Singular, ...) ignore IABTCF and still need their own registry entries.

methods.name: loadAndShowConsentFormIfRequired
methods.note: PRIMARY interception (stable public class). Instead of loading/showing the consent form, writes reject-all IABTCF_* (gdprApplies=1 always, all-zero purpose/vendor consent + legitimate-interest keys, reject-all TCString, AddtlConsent='1~') to PreferenceManager.getDefaultSharedPreferences() — the exact store UMP's consent_sdk and every TCF SDK read — then calls the passed OnConsentFormDismissedListener.onConsentFormDismissed(null) so the app proceeds as if the user chose 'reject all'. The dialog is never shown.

methods.name: requestConsentInfoUpdate
methods.note: Concrete ConsentInformation impl (OBFUSCATED, version-specific — this is the class implementing com.google.android.ump.ConsentInformation in UMP 4.0.0 as shipped in the test app; re-identify for other versions). Fires the success listener immediately (no network) so the app's consent flow continues straight to loadAndShowConsentFormIfRequired. Signature-guarded in neutralize.sh; a wrong/absent class is safely skipped.

methods.name: canRequestAds
methods.note: Return true so the app proceeds to initialize ads (which then self-limit under the reject-all TCF state, and can be neutralized separately). Coherent with getConsentStatus=OBTAINED.

methods.name: getConsentStatus
methods.note: Return OBTAINED (3): the app treats consent as completed/handled and never re-shows the form. Coherent with gdprApplies=1 + reject-all (a completed reject-all choice), unlike NOT_REQUIRED which would contradict gdprApplies=1.
